name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx as a multi-site web server for three virtual hosts, including site content, SSL configuration, service lifecycle, firewall, Fail2ban, SSH hardening, and kernel security settings.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including password-protected Redis on port 6379 and cleanup of incompatible generated configuration directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a Python FastAPI application from GitHub, including its virtual environment, dependencies, local PostgreSQL database and credentials, environment configuration, and systemd/Uvicorn service on port 8000.
